findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "submit_bundles" is 868 chars, far longer than this server's median (73). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Queue bundle root URLs served by a host you own. IndexNow rules: the key file at https://<host>/<key>.txt has to match, the answer is 202, and nothing of yours …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_bundles, get_bundle, submit_bundles · Private data: submit_bundles · Public sink: submit_bundles.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_bundles, get_bundle, submit_bundles · Private data: submit_bundles · Public sink: submit_bundles

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
